description.text: The fifth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 22 March 2024 with 218 cards: 162 and 56 secret rares. It brought back ACE SPEC cards, first seen in Boundaries Crossed in 2012, of which a deck may hold only one, with six Trainers and a Special Energy, and more Ancient and Future Pokémon, among them Walking Wake ex and Raging Bolt ex, Iron Leaves ex and Iron Crown ex. It was the first set with the H regulation mark.
